title: WARRANT waiver
description: An explicit, time-limited exception from one gate for one Change (05 section 7). A waiver is not a policy change.

id.description: Waiver id `WAV-<ULID>`, or the former `WAV-<year>-NNN`, which stays valid (02 section 3, ADR-0056 p. 2).

gate.description: Gate this waiver applies to. Gates with `waivable: false` cannot be waived.

reason.description: Why the gate cannot be satisfied.

risk.description: Risk accepted by granting this waiver.

owner.description: Role or person accountable for the accepted risk.

approved_by.description: Human who approved the waiver, as `human:<login>`. An agent may propose but not approve. Required in every state except `PROPOSED` (05 section 7).

expires_at.description: Date after which the waiver becomes EXPIRED and the gate is re-evaluated.

targets.description: Narrows the waiver to individual objects the gate counts one by one (05 section 7, ADR-0016). The kernel only requires objects: their shape is declared by the pack that provides the gate and is checked by `warrant validate` as a second step (D-13).

items.description: One waived target; its shape is declared by the pack of the gate.
